memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So Moses told the Israelites to celebrate the Passover, and they did so in the Desert of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses. - Num 9:4-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses passed on God's command, and the people obeyed. They kept the Passover at exactly the right time, in exactly the right way — "everything just as the Lord commanded Moses." Once again we meet that steady refrain of full obedience that runs through the book of Numbers.

There is something quietly beautiful about a whole community obeying God together, carefully and completely. They did not keep the feast half-heartedly or make up their own version. They followed God's instructions faithfully, honouring both the timing and the manner He had given.

Worship and remembrance are meant to be done God's way, not merely as we feel like doing them. This does not make worship cold or mechanical — the Passover was full of meaning and joy. But that meaning was carried within the pattern God gave. Faithful obedience and heartfelt worship belong together.

We sometimes imagine that loving God freely means we can approach Him however we please. But true love listens carefully and honours the wishes of the one loved. When we obey God in the details, we are not being legalistic; we are showing that we take Him seriously and treasure His word.

The people obeyed even in the wilderness, even a year into their journey, even when it would have been easy to let the practice slip. Let their example encourage you. Whatever God has asked of you, do it — carefully, faithfully, and from the heart.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you tend to worship God your own way or His way?
- How can careful obedience and heartfelt worship go together?
- What has God clearly asked of you that you can obey today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, teach me to obey You carefully and from the heart. Help me to honour Your word in the details, not out of duty, but out of love. Amen.
